title: MainSystem.Inspect
author: JG
description: add function MainSystem.Inspect(itemIndex, what, optArgs) which retrieves additional info on items like available output variables, node/marker types, etc.
releaseNotes: mbs.Inspect(itemIndex, what) asks an item what it provides and requests: output variables, type flags, requested node and marker types, access functions, as lists of exudyn enumeration members; what is a member of exu.InspectType, or None for all that apply. The output variables list the energies only where the item can compute them with its current parameters.
